<!-- auto-status-summary:start -->
## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
Controlled public CSV fixture task for one real Closer end-to-end test. The initial partial fixture revision is intentionally incomplete and must never be described as completed implementation. These requirements remain unchanged before and after that initial merge.

#### Tasks
- [ ] Inspect export_rows(rows, format) in tests/fixtures/closer_real_csv_canary/v1/csv_export.py and preserve its existing JSON round-trip behavior for the fixed fields name and score.
- [ ] Add tests/fixtures/closer_real_csv_canary/v1/verify_csv_contract.py as an explicitly invoked standard-library-only contract script covering JSON preservation, CSV header and record endings, input record counts, special-character round trips, empty input and unsupported formats.
- [ ] Run verify_csv_contract.py against the initial partial revision before correcting csv_export.py; retain the revision identity, command, output and nonzero exit status as evidence of the genuine contract failure.
- [ ] Implement CSV export in tests/fixtures/closer_real_csv_canary/v1/csv_export.py with exactly the header name,score, CRLF record endings and one record per input; support commas, quotes, LF and CR through Python csv.reader.
- [ ] Make export_rows(rows, format) in csv_export.py raise ValueError for unsupported formats.
- [ ] Run the same verify_csv_contract.py command after correction and retain its output and exit status.
- [ ] Before declaring the controlled Closer test complete, obtain genuine native Verify outcomes and corrective worker/publication proof tied to the fixture revisions and the test-labeled issue, branch and PR chain; report missing evidence explicitly.

#### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CSV output from csv_export.py starts with exactly name,score\r\n and contains one CSV record per input row, with CRLF record terminators.
- [ ] Python csv.reader recovers the field values for inputs containing commas, quotes, LF and CR, including cases where those characters occur together.
- [ ] Empty CSV input returns exactly name,score\r\n.
- [ ] Existing JSON round-trip behavior for name and score remains unchanged, and unsupported formats raise ValueError.

- [ ] Repository changes are confined to csv_export.py and verify_csv_contract.py in tests/fixtures/closer_real_csv_canary/v1/.
- [ ] Every issue, branch and PR in the chain is visibly labeled as a test.

Use Python's csv module to implement quoting and parsing, and distinguish record terminators from CR or LF embedded inside quoted fields.
